rootCause.summary: A structured Claude restart fell back to the descriptor's persisted resolved model id. Claude native initialization persists the bare resolved id without the launcher's [1m] suffix, so the restored 1M transcript was relaunched explicitly as a 200K model and rejected locally before the resumed request reached the gateway.

run20Evidence.firstRequest: HTTP 200 through the 1M route with inputTotal 838526
run20Evidence.resumedRequest: No gateway request; Claude rejected the restored conversation locally with Prompt is too long

repair.behavior: prepareStructuredSuResume reapplies normalizeModelSpecForAgent('claude', model) before account-route resolution and SDK launch.

recurrenceGuard.assertion: A persisted bare claude-fable-5-1 model is restored as claude-fable-5-1[1m], and account-route resolution receives the decorated model spec.

run21.command: PUI_REAL_ENGINE=1 PUI_REAL_BACKEND=claude PUI_REAL_ACCOUNT=auto PUI_NATIVE_ACCOUNT_CATALOG=/tmp/pui-p006-native-accounts-2026-09-08.json PUI_BIN=@home@/.cargo/bin/pui npm run test:file -- packages/operator-core/lib/pui-e2e/agent-chat-pty.integration.test.ts -t 'restores the same native conversation after the operator OS process exits'

conversation.assertion: The selected test also requires a completed assistant transcript event matching the exact resumed reply.

gateway.metricSemantics: inputTotal is written from the upstream message_start usage as input_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens. observedInputFloor is the minimum inputTotal retained for that native session.

typecheck.result: package-wide red, unrelated to the repaired files
typecheck.detail: The command expanded to operator-core scope=all and reported 11 files above baseline. Neither repaired file was among them; concurrent peer edits were explicitly identified for two reported files.

limits: The installed PUI binary was exercised against current operator source; its manifest sourceSha predates this repair and is not presented as the operator-source provenance.
The test runner stamps only the named integration file. The seven governing hashes above remained stable, but the entire transitive import graph was not frozen.
This artifact closes the Claude OS-process-restart context-overflow bug only; it does not complete all P-006 parity or authorize P-015 publication.
